correctness.rationale: Height lifts of proper three-colourings of trees change at exactly one vertex by ±2 per legal move. A closed walk has a uniform height shift divisible by six; parity and L1 lower bounds force all odd walks to length at least 3n and prohibit them at even n. Sorting heights and lowering each vertex by two in three sweeps yields a legal closed walk of length 3n. Inductive connectivity, two-leaf square existence and direct edge incidence establish all stated corollaries. Exhaustive independent finite checks pass for all 146 labelled trees through five vertices and eight additional larger trees.
